title: Gecko's Session Timers
description: A basic timer for sessions on servers every player can see, with simple easy to use commands, simple GUI, easy to run and set up!
body:
A simple GUI for Recording Sessions, use to your hearts content!


- Shared timer for all players
- Preset session lengths (30m, 1h, 2h, etc.)
- Pause and resume support
- Automatic end message
- Perfect for YouTube or event servers

How to use:
1. Put the datapack in your world’s datapacks folder
2. Run /reload
3. Use /function session:start_2h (or other presets)

Commands:
- /function session:start_30m
- /function session:start_60m
- /function session:start_90m
- /function session:start_2h
- /function session:pause
- /function session:resume
- /function session:stop
